evidence: chatService.messages reads the newest MESSAGE_PAGE_SIZE (50) messages and takes a `before` timestamp for the page above; ChatThread shows 'Load earlier messages' once a full page is loaded. A long thread no longer fetches every message it has ever held.

OtpVerify.set() builds the next digits with the updater form of setState, so a keystroke that lands before React re-renders no longer overwrites the previous digit. The paste/SMS-autofill path is unchanged.

entityPasswordService.isRecoverySet waits for the session and retries once when the first call fails, instead of reading a 401 (the call landing before the session is attached) as 'no backup question set' — which hid the recovery route from someone who has one. The underlying 401 is platform clock skew (PGRST303) and is not something the app can prevent.

Migration 20260973 replaced the messages insert policy (it called _user_blocks_exists, which authenticated may not execute) with one using is_blocked_between, and fixed notify_on_chat_message. Applied on staging, where E2E critical/chat sends text and photos both ways, checks unread at the database level and the block path. Production apply is pending owner approval — until then chat send is still broken there.

77 label/control pairs across 28 files now carry htmlFor/id (codemod plus the multi-line cases by hand), so a screen reader announces each field by its visible label and tapping the label focuses it. New audit scripts/audit/label-association.mjs reports 0 and exits non-zero if any reappear; labels that wrap their control or name a group of chips are correctly not counted.
